description: Learn how to greet people and make introductions in Spanish. This unit helps you choose the right words depending on the situation—friendly or formal—and gives you the tools to start a conversation naturally.
title: Greetings

description: Learn how to keep a simple conversation going in Spanish after greetings and introductions. In this unit, you’ll ask how someone is, talk about where you’re from and what you do, and politely close a short conversation.
title: Basic Conversations

description: Learn how all nouns that refer to objects and concepts have a gender in Spanish. Learn how to determine and use a nouns gender.
title: Nouns: All Objects have a Gender

description: Communicative Goal: start interactions and share basic personal information.
title: Talking about who you are

description: Learn how grammatical gender works in Spanish nouns, how to recognize it, and how to use nouns correctly with articles.
title: Nouns: Grammatical Gender
